scope: synthetic living-world engineering checks; rates are design defaults, not calibrated
checks: needs fall per waking or sleeping hour from the last update (energy refills asleep, capped at 1); reading them is pure
rooms in a site are within walking reach; another site needs a route (no teleporting); rain lengthens routes
a classmate cannot use or walk into another family's home; school and other public places are open
a hungry person's best-ranked option is to cook (need relief minus travel)
an activity is seen by people in the room, takes its minutes, and only completes (raising needs) if the person stays
people know where others are only from what they saw or heard; someone leaving makes their whereabouts unknown
going to talk walks to the person and opens a conversation there; someone gone or asleep is noticed instead
near the end of the waking day a person at home walks back to their own room
a happening reaches only people in the room and, for sounds, in rooms within earshot
a power cut takes out the powered objects of the whole site (not the school) and they work again two hours later
a fire drill interrupts conversations on the school site and releases their reserved turns
the cat wanders its rooms on its own (15 sightings in a day); people there notice it and can play with it
a scripted living day (choices, activities, visits, happenings, weather, the cat) is deterministic, ends with everyone in their own room, and resumes from a mid-day checkpoint to the same world
live choice (stubbed model): a worried thought picks "go and talk", the grandmother walks to the child's room and opens the conversation there, which ends on its own
a busy person in transit (no room) gets a context with no physical environment instead of crashing
unknown room kinds, creatures outside their rooms, bad settings and person-happenings without self_text are rejected
